chapter: Circus shows and learning to voice
title: A year or two in Chicago, then Kansas City
summary: He stayed in Chicago about a year or two before going into the business seriously in Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: Yeah. So how long did you stay there?

About a year or two. I'm trying to remember where I went when I left there. That's when I really went into the business heavy. Went from there on into Kansas City. But what I want to say about this band -- I don't want to jump the subject.
